verdicts.label: SCAM
verdicts.what_is_true_en: The Indian government and Prime Minister Modi are not offering any free mobile recharge schemes. Messages promoting such offers are fraudulent and the associated links are designed to steal personal data or money.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple independent fact-checking organizations and news outlets have consistently debunked the claim that the Indian government or Prime Minister Modi is offering free mobile recharge. The government's Press Information Bureau (PIB) has also issued clarifications, stating no such scheme exists. The evidence shows this is a recurring scam that uses different pretexts (elections, festivals) to lure people into clicking malicious links designed for phishing and data theft.
